evidence.excerpt: Both components, however, have important limitations: static policies must anticipate possible user intents and therefore do not scale to open-ended tasks, while LLM-driven authorization supports dynamic decisions but produces inconsistent outcomes and remains vulnerable to targeted IPI attacks.

evidence.label: 讨论泛化、污染、稳健性或人工核验
evidence.excerpt: The results show that MetaPermit produces 31% more consistent authorization decisions than LLM-driven authorization and outperforms the state-of-the-art defenses CaMeL and IPIGuard in both task completion, with improvements of up to 109%, and robustness to IPI attacks, with no malicious tool calls executed.
